title: PICACO: Pluralistic In-Context Value Alignment via Total Correlation Optimization

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses using an LLM-as-a-judge (GPT-4o and DeepSeek-V3.1) to score 'Bias' on a 1-5 scale. This metric measures the violation of 'Fairness', specifically checking for social stereotypes, unfair discrimination, and the unjust representation or treatment of marginalized groups on safety datasets like BeaverTails and Do-Not-Answer.

bias_targets.target: Value bias (Cultural and philosophical preference bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the overall conformity of language models across distinct, pluralistic human value systems (e.g., Confucianism, Modern Liberalism, Schwartz Basic Human Values, Helpful & Harmless). This evaluates whether models or alignment methods exhibit bias toward specific value types when instructed to navigate conflicting demands (value tensions).
